description: The World Food Programme has increased food aid distribution in drought-affected Tigray to reach an additional 500,000 people, addressing high food security concerns following recent climatic shocks.
title: WFP Scales Up Food Aid in Tigray

description: Programs have been initiated in the Amhara region, in collaboration with humanitarian partners, to facilitate the voluntary return and safe reintegration of internally displaced persons.
title: IDP Returns Facilitated in Amhara

description: The WHO and Ministry of Health are intensifying cholera prevention and response campaigns in Ethiopia's Somali region due to a rise in reported cases, focusing on improved water sanitation and hygiene.
title: Cholera Campaigns Intensify in Somali Region

description: Heavy seasonal rains have caused significant flooding in parts of the Afar and Oromia regions, displacing over 20,000 people and damaging infrastructure. Humanitarian assessments are ongoing.
title: Seasonal Flooding Displaces 20,000 in Afar and Oromia

description: A new report indicates deteriorating food security in southern Ethiopia due to persistent drought and localized conflict, requiring urgent humanitarian interventions.
title: Worsening Food Insecurity in Southern Ethiopia

description: Lifesaving food assistance has been distributed to over 50,000 people in remote parts of Tigray, but significant food insecurity persists across the region.
title: Food Insecurity in Tigray

description: Recent escalations in conflict have led to a new wave of displacement in Ethiopia's Amhara region, with thousands fleeing their homes and needing emergency shelter.
title: Displacement in Amhara Region

description: A cholera outbreak in several woredas of the Somali Region has been successfully contained due to rapid response and vaccination campaigns, though continued hygiene practices are urged to prevent resurgence.
title: Cholera Outbreak in Somali Region

description: Heavy rainfall has triggered flash floods in parts of the Afar Region, forcing hundreds of families to evacuate their homes and seek temporary shelter, with aid operations underway.
title: Flash Floods in Afar Region

description: A new UNICEF report highlights a concerning increase in severe acute malnutrition among children in drought-stricken areas of Oromia, with the agency scaling up nutrition programs.
title: Child Malnutrition in Oromia
